title: Review and merge duplicate client profiles
summary: Keep the right profile and preserve connected history after a careful comparison.

sections.title: Confirm it is one person
sections.body:
A shared phone or email does not always mean two records are the same person. Families and colleagues may share contact details. Only merge after checking identity and history with appropriate access.

Merge controls require separate permission and appear when **Possible duplicates** are available in the client’s **Client records** section.

sections.title: Review and confirm
sections.body:
1. Open the profile you intend to keep.
2. Choose **Client records → Possible duplicates**.
3. Read the candidate’s name and matching reasons, then select **Preview merge**.
4. Carefully check **Keep [client name]**, the other profile, the missing fields to fill and the connected-record counts.
5. Enter **Required merge reason**.
6. Select **Merge into this profile** only when the retained profile is correct.
7. Open the resulting profile and verify visits and supporting records.

The duplicate profile is retired while its registered appointment, sale, deposit, note, form, file, consent and privacy links are preserved.

sections.title: If the preview becomes stale
sections.body:
Someone may have changed either record while you reviewed it. Refresh, compare the current profiles and generate another preview. Do not keep confirming an outdated comparison.

Merging is not a way to remove an incorrect payment or a privacy request. Those records keep their own history and correction process. Where identity is uncertain, leave the profiles separate and ask an authorized owner to review.
